title: QBR prioritization cheat sheet - ICP & deployment focus
content:
Purpose:
This is a quick, actionable sheet for CS Managers and AEs to prioritize accounts for upcoming QBRs and renewal outreach. Focus is specifically on segmentation by ICP fit and deployment mode (hosted, dedicated, private) with an additional regional lens. Use it as the canonical short-list filter before building decks or triggering escalations.

How to use (1-page workflow):
- Pull renewal window (90/60/30 days) and ARR from SFDC export.
- Enrich with deployment mode + region from account metadata (platform telemetry).
- Score accounts across the rubric below.
- Bucket into Priority A/B/C and assign playbook steps.
- Surface top 10 A accounts for exec review; top 20 for AM+CS pairing.

Columns (sheet layout) - one row per account:
- account_name
- sf_account_id
- renewal_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- ARR (USD)
- ICP_fit_score (0-10) -> see rubric below
- deployment_mode -> hosted | dedicated | private
- region -> NAM | EMEA | APAC | LATAM
- current_MRU (monthly model runtime units) -> proxy for usage
- CSAT_last_90d (1-10)
- open_p1_tickets (int)
- feature_adoption_flags (list of short codes, e.g., SSO, VPC, RERANK)
- exec_sponsor (Y/N)
- product_dependencies (short note)
- expansion_signals (Y/N) -> e.g., new product request, pilot requests
- renewal_priority_score (computed 0-100)
- priority_bucket -> A | B | C
- next_action_owner -> AM | CSM | SolutionsEng | Escalations
- next_action_due (YYYY-MM-DD)

Scoring rubric (weights) - normalize to 100:
- ARR weight: 30 -> normalized by percentile within portfolio
- ICP fit: 20 -> higher weight if core ICP (ai-native/integrators)
- Deployment mode: 15 -> private (15), dedicated (10), hosted (5) (higher = more operational risk/cost)
- Region risk: 5 -> EMEA/APAC sometimes higher due to regional regs (adjust per quarter)
- Usage (MRU): 10 -> upward trend gets +, churn trend gets -
- CSAT & support signals: 10 -> low CSAT (+ risk) and open P1s increase score
- Expansion signals / exec sponsor: 10 -> presence reduces immediate churn risk but raises expansion opportunity -> score adjusts for both (see formula below)

Quick formula (sheet cell friendly):
renewal_priority_score = round(ARR_pct*0.30 + ICP_score*0.20 + deployment_score*0.15 + region_score*0.05 + usage_pct*0.10 + support_risk*0.10 + expansion_modifier*0.10)
notes: ARR_pct/usage_pct computed as 0-100 percentiles across the active renewal set; ICP_score scaled 0-100; deployment_score mapped (private=100, dedicated=67, hosted=33); support_risk = (open_p1*15 + (10-CSAT_last_90d)*5) capped at 100; expansion_modifier = if expansion_signals=Y then -10 (lower priority for rescue, but mark for growth play) else +0

Bucket mapping (suggested):
- Priority A: score >= 70 -> immediate commercial play + exec briefing + SRE readiness check for private/dedicated
- Priority B: 45-69 -> AM+CSM joint outreach, enable playbooks, check adoption blockers
- Priority C: <45 -> standard renewal outreach cadence, automated check-ins, track for expansion signals

Playbook actions (by bucket & deployment) - short actionable templates
Priority A - private/dedicated:
- 30d: schedule exec QBR (AM+CSM+Eng Lead). Deliverable: 1-pager on uptime, latency, cost delta vs prior quarter, open P1 remediation plan.
- 20d: SolutionsEng run a technical health-check (KV cache, quant settings, peak-window logs). Send ops checklist.
- 14d: commercial: propose 12-mo reserved capacity discount or hybrid routing credit. Include rollback SLA terms.
- 7d: legal/compliance pre-sign review for any contract language about data residency.

Priority A - hosted (large ARR but low infra ownership):
- 30d: AM-led business outcomes doc + top 3 latency/cost wins we can deliver in next quarter.
- 14d: Offer pilot of dedicated for critical traffic or provide cost optimization plan from Redwood Optimize.

Priority B (all deployments):
- 45d: CSM-run adoption deep-dive; identify top 3 features not adopted (SSO, VPC, batching).
- 21d: Launch tailored adoption plan: 1 tech office hour + 1 integration ticket prioritized.
- 7d: Confirm renewal intent and capture blocker notes into SFDC.

Priority C:
- Automated nudges: 60/30/14/7 day emails + templated content.
- Track for expansion signals (if Y -> move to B).

Templates to copy into outreach (short snippets):
- Exec invite subject: "QBR prep: [Account] — roadmap alignment + SLA review"
- Health-check request (to SE): "Please run infra health-check for [account_id]. Focus: token throughput, batch latencies, KV-cache hit ratio. Attach logs to JIRA-CS-XXXX."
- Cost optimization teaser: "We see 18% opportunity via batching + quant profile change; would you like a POC?"

Operational notes & data sources:
- SFDC: ARR, renewal_date, exec sponsor
- Telemetry DB (platform): usage MRU, deployment_mode, region, feature flags
- CSAT survey tool: last 90d score
- Support queue (Zendesk/JIRA): open_p1 counts and ticket links
- Product signals: feature flags usage, API error rates (from observability)

Unresolved questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- should region scoring treat APAC/EMEA differently for specific enterprise deals? (ask sales ops)
- confirm list of ICP traits that map to +10 (verticals? data-sensitivity? go-to-market motion?)
- add column for legal/regulatory sensitivity (HIPAA, SOC2 type) — impacts playbook for private
- automate percentile computations via BigQuery scheduled job (CS Eng ticket backlog)

Quick sample rows (mock) to sanity-check formula - paste into sheet during dry run:
1) Acme Integrations | SF-10023 | 2025-03-15 | 1,200,000 | ICP 90 | private | EMEA | MRU 420k | CSAT 8 | P1 0 | SSO,VPC | ExecN | core payment pipeline | expansion Y | score 82 -> A
2) Midwest SaaS Co | SF-11044 | 2025-06-01 | 210,000 | ICP 65 | hosted | NAM | MRU 50k | CSAT 9 | P1 0 | SDK | Y | non-core | expansion N | score 48 -> B
3) RetailPilot | SF-12022 | 2025-01-12 | 35,000 | ICP 30 | dedicated | APAC | MRU 4k | CSAT 6 | P1 2 | RERANK | N | compliance low | score 71 -> A (high support risk + private-like infra)

Handy shortcuts (for the sheet owner):
- conditional formatting: priority_score >=70 -> red band; 45-69 amber; <45 green (makes list visual for execs)
- add filter view per region and per deployment_mode for weekly review meetings
- add a "last_touched_by" column and require owner update before weekly QBR sync

References + copy-paste snippets for decks:
- 1-slide health snapshot: renewal_date | ARR | priority_score | top_3_risks | proposed_action
- 1-pager for exec: impact on revenue + cost to remediate + timeline

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally compact. We expect pockets of local adjustments (sales comp, regional regs). Please comment inline with examples from your book-of-business.

Change log (history):
- 2024-11-03 Sofia M created initial draft
- 2024-12-10 Marcus L added scoring tweaks for deployment_weight
- 2025-02-14 Priya N added sample rows and playbook language

End.
